title: Synonyms, Antonyms, and Homophones
description: Word relationship practice. Synonyms (words with similar meanings), antonyms (opposites), and homophones (words that sound alike but are spelled differently and mean different things).
subject: language-arts
source: Common Core ELA vocabulary standards L.2.5, L.3.5, L.4.5, L.5.5. Word selection drawn from typical grade-level vocabulary lists.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of big?
Which word is a synonym of happy?
Which word is a synonym of fast?
Which word is a synonym of start?
Which word is a synonym of little?
Which word is an antonym of hot?
Which word is an antonym of up?
Which word is an antonym of day?
Which word is an antonym of full?
Which word is a homophone of see?
items.context: See means to look at something. Sea is a large body of salt water. They sound alike but mean different things.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank: 'I want ___ go to the park.'
items.context: All three (to, too, two) sound the same but mean different things. 'To' is a preposition (go TO the park). 'Too' means also or very. 'Two' is the number 2.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of begin?
Which word is a synonym of shout?
Which word is a synonym of smart?
Which word is an antonym of brave?
Which word is an antonym of gather?
Which word is a homophone of their?
items.context: Their shows ownership (their book). There is a place (over there). They're is a contraction for 'they are'. All three sound the same.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of knight?
items.context: Knight is a medieval warrior. Night is when it's dark outside. The K in knight is silent.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of hear?
items.context: Hear means to listen with your ears. Here means in this place.
items.mnemonic: You hear with your ear (both end in -ear).

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of courageous?
Which word is a synonym of enormous?
Which word is a synonym of examine?
Which word is an antonym of ancient?
Which word is an antonym of arrive?
Which word is a homophone of peace?
items.context: Peace means calm or no war. Piece means a part of something (a piece of pie).

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of weather?
items.context: Weather is the climate outside. Whether means 'if' (I don't know whether to go).

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of diligent?
Which word is a synonym of benevolent?
Which word is a synonym of reluctant?
Which word is an antonym of abundant?
Which word is an antonym of expand?
Which word is a homophone of principal?
items.context: Principal is the head of a school (your pal). Principle is a rule or belief. They sound identical.

items.prompt: Which word is a homophone of compliment?
items.context: Compliment (with an i) is a kind remark. Complement (with an e) means to complete or go well with.

items.prompt: Which word is a synonym of meticulous?
Which word is a synonym of obsolete?
Which word is an antonym of transparent?
Which word is an antonym of frugal?
Which word is a homophone of affect?
items.context: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence (The rain affected the game). Effect is usually a noun meaning the result (The effect was dramatic).
items.mnemonic: A is for action (verb, affect). E is for end result (noun, effect).
